binding_semantics.scope: Per World run-local state; Advisor receipts span its task; each actual Registrar Agent.run has a fresh random conversation scope. Direct host calls have no fabricated inspection history.
binding_semantics.policies: Separate cached factory instances for physical dispatcher, originating role and scope. Advisor delegation and nested Registrar/helper execution never re-enter the same session.
binding_semantics.snapshot: facts callback constructs complete Field rows on the current runtime request ID. Failed backend/list acquisition propagates; never substitute empty observed sets. Historical Fields come only from successful action/observation pairs at original World.log.
binding_semantics.identity: World.actor is the trusted synthetic actor. Application-created Agent.run binds originating role. caller_context transports that role; it is not independent authentication.
binding_semantics.history: Only actual original result shapes establish read/plan inspection receipts; rejected/error results and mere action events cannot. Internal enrollment_block/defer context calculations do not establish agent inspection.
binding_semantics.storage: Snapshot observer mode, not managed checkpoint writes. No Event success inference, output-field inventions, numeric surrogate measurements, timestamps or extra schemas.
binding_semantics.schema_cardinality: Exact frozen runtime contract; authenticated_actor is one-valued; all other selected fields are many-valued symbols. No numeric fields or units selected.
binding_semantics.concurrency: Original synchronous, single-process, synthetic lifecycle only. No shared transaction between original store and runtime observations.

fields.name: authenticated_actor
fields.meaning: Actual World.actor associated with the current native request's application instance.
fields.scope: One immutable request-specific object identified by the native request ID; run-local World authority. Never read from request.student_id, context text or an inter-agent claim.
fields.missing: No protected-target Allow without this observation; acquisition failure follows the real error path. Missing is not a wildcard.
fields.producer: Trusted dispatch adapter observes the bound application's World immediately before its gate. This is planned instrumentation of existing state, not an existing framework fact.

fields.name: student_key
fields.meaning: Actual student dictionary keys in the trusted run-local store.
fields.scope: Complete key set frozen on the current request object before a Registrar decision. Used to preserve original unknown-ID error/rejection paths, not to authorize access or expose another record.
fields.missing: An empty complete set differs from failed acquisition. Failed acquisition must not publish an apparently complete empty snapshot.
fields.producer: Dispatch adapter enumerates World.students keys only; no record contents for a mismatched target are returned to the agent.

evidence.quote:
if student_id not in self.world.students:
            return {"status": "error", "reason": "unknown_student"}

fields.name: course_key
fields.scope: Complete current key set on the request-specific snapshot; immutable synthetic catalog structure within this run, with mutable seat values left to original checks.
fields.missing: Unknown course retains the original error or explicit rejection path. Snapshot acquisition failure cannot be interpreted as an unknown course.
fields.producer: Trusted Registrar dispatch adapter observes World.catalog keys before the gate.

evidence.quote:
if course not in self.world.catalog:
            return {"status": "error", "reason": "unknown_course"}

fields.name: completed_course
fields.meaning: Members of the target actor's actual trusted completed-course list.
fields.scope: Complete target-specific set on the current enroll request object. Captured immediately before the original write-time body, only for an authorized existing target. Request identity supplies version granularity; never reuse an older snapshot.
fields.missing: An observed empty list means no completions. Unavailable or malformed record data raises rather than being treated as an empty trusted record.
fields.producer: Trusted adapter reads World.students[student_id]['completed']; user requests, catalog notes, proposed courses and waiver flags are never producers.

evidence.quote:
if set(entry["requires"]) - set(student["completed"]) and not waive:
        return "missing_prerequisites", None

fields.name: required_prerequisite
fields.meaning: Members of the requested course's trusted catalog requires list.
fields.scope: Complete requested-course set on the same enroll request object as completed_course; freshly captured before the synchronous original body. Not the external catalog note.
fields.missing: A genuinely empty requires list imposes no prerequisite. Missing course uses its original error path; malformed or uncaptured requires cannot certify no prerequisites.
fields.producer: Trusted adapter reads the actual World.catalog[course]['requires'] list. Rules deny any member not present in completed_course, without a custom IDB.

fields.name: requested_course
fields.meaning: Actual requested course IDs in the application's task specification, not a model-generated substitute list.
fields.scope: Current request snapshot for Advisor planning/delegation, tied to the same EnrollmentApplication task. The original plan body retains multiplicity and full-list validation; this set is only inspection coverage.
fields.missing: Do not claim complete inspection from failed task acquisition. An actual empty request retains original completion behavior rather than receiving fabricated work.
fields.producer: Trusted adapter observes self.spec['request']['courses'] at the real planning/delegation boundary.

fields.name: catalog_receipt
fields.meaning: Identity of an actual successful read_catalog action/observation pair by the deciding role.
fields.scope: Frozen historical associations on the current decision request. Advisor scope is this actor's whole task; Registrar scope is this proposal's fresh conversation. Successful Advisor helper receipts are attributed to Advisor, not Registrar. Unrelated conversations and raw unseen history are not added to model inputs.
fields.missing: No corresponding successful receipt means the catalog-inspection prerequisite is unmet. An attempt, error or catalog assertion is insufficient.
fields.producer: observe_public_event pairs real Agent.run action and observation records by call_id, role and conversation, retaining successful original catalog results. The snapshot freezes at record_plan, ask_registrar, enroll, defer or substantive reject.

fields.name: student_receipt
fields.meaning: Student IDs for actual successful Registrar read_student receipts.
fields.scope: Current Registrar decision request, complete observed successful-read history of this proposal only. The value identifies the actual read target; it does not repeat or expose the private record.
fields.missing: No matched successful read means the relevant inspection is unmet, except the preserved no-read explicit-rejection path for unknown or unauthorized targets.
fields.producer: observe_public_event pairs original read_student action arguments with its real non-error observation. Snapshot producer selects the current trusted actor/proposal, never a model self-report.

fields.name: context_receipt
fields.meaning: Student IDs for actual successful agent-requested read_enrollment_context receipts.
fields.scope: Current decision request; Advisor task-wide or Registrar proposal-wide according to the trusted originating role. Internal enrollment_block/defer computations are not counted as an agent having inspected context.
fields.missing: No successful matching target receipt means appointment/budget inspection is unmet. Context prose and an attempted read cannot replace it.
fields.producer: observe_public_event pairs action arguments and actual result. The underlying original enrollment_context calculation is delegated trusted accounting, not a newly implemented Datalog sum or policy predicate.

evidence.quote:
if name == "read_enrollment_context":
            return enrollment_context(self.world.students, self.world.catalog, self.world.now, student_id)

fields.name: section_receipt
fields.meaning: Course IDs for actual successful search_sections receipts for the current decision's authenticated target.
fields.scope: Current request snapshot. Advisor history spans the actor's task; Registrar history spans this proposal. Target, role and proposal selection are based on original action/result metadata. This is historical inspection evidence, not a fresh seat guarantee.
fields.missing: No corresponding successful course search means relevant-section inspection is unmet. A previous proposal's private history is not borrowed.
fields.producer: observe_public_event pairs the real search action's student_id/course with its successful result, including availability_is_snapshot.

evidence.quote:
if name == "search_sections":
            return search_sections(self.world.students, self.world.catalog, self.world.now, student_id, course)

fields.name: plan_receipt
fields.meaning: Identity of an actual successful record_plan receipt for this authenticated actor and task.
fields.scope: Current ask_registrar request snapshot. Produced only after the unchanged original body validates and stores the complete requested course list. It does not certify delegation order, priority entitlement or future enrollment.
fields.missing: No actual planned receipt blocks delegation until the Advisor uses its existing tools to record a plan.
fields.producer: observe_public_event retains only the real status=planned result, paired with its action; no agent can assert this Field.

concrete_gaps: Discovery uses the supplied original-source, contract and runtime-guide bundle, including Semantic boundaries for port-in. No filesystem inspection, execution, source revision resolution or native coverage verification occurred. No unseen source.json metadata, additional files or framework modules are assumed.

P1: Both roles' student-specific context/search paths and Registrar read_student/enroll lack actor-to-target authorization. Matching a plan to the request does not authorize that request's target. Trusted actor binding must come from World, with role attribution preserved across Advisor calls into registrar_tool. No delegated-access workflow exists.

P2/P3: Original enrollment_block honors model-supplied waive and the Registrar prompt explicitly invites waiver judgments. These conflict with policy, not policy ambiguity. A corrective gate must deny waiver claims and missing trusted prerequisites before mutation without replacing legitimate original checks.

P4/P6/P7: Existing guards use trusted fixture profiles and timezone-aware simulation time, retain all enrolled units, and recheck enrollment conditions immediately before a synchronous write. Concurrent registration, external state mutation, persistence and crash reconciliation are not supported. A failed or interrupted effect must not be declared rolled back without evidence.

P5/P9: Agent.run records ordinary dispatch exceptions but not a per-action KeyboardInterrupt observation. A failed batch can leave later function calls from the same model response unexecuted and without individual interruption records. A run-level runtime error is not automatically a terminal record for each pending call.

P9: Catalog/context/section inspection order and complete-plan-before-delegation are largely prompt obligations. The completion path only requires a plan for selected scenarios and validates proposal order after execution. Registrar terminal receipt before reporting, proposal-scoped evidence and permitted same-role repair need explicit observations at the real decision boundaries; mere Event existence cannot establish success.

P5/P10: Arbitrary natural-language enrollment claims, public-summary content, catalog-note laundering and exact minimal-disclosure equivalence have no existing authoritative semantic classifier. Conservative provenance can establish possible influence, not prove that a reply contains or excludes a specific private value. Preserve these limitations rather than treating absence of a provenance label as clean content.

Content provenance is not currently instrumented. Native run_id, event step, response_id and call_id identify runs/events/responses/calls but do not identify every input object version, context snapshot, copied projection, tool-result body or state revision. Future adapters need version-specific direct identities at actual assembly/copy/consumption points; those planned identities are not existing observations.

Complete per-turn context is available in memory in Agent.run and at OpenAIResponses.create, but not fully recoverable from public trace records because encrypted reasoning items are omitted and requests log only turn/model. Dependency capture must occur on the live path without exporting hidden reasoning. Missing capture cannot certify origin absence.

Keep exact content lineage separate from cumulative task exposure. Each Registrar history is fresh, yet it may legitimately read updated authorized store state from earlier proposals. Do not attach another Registrar's private history or unrelated initial/final audit records to the new model context; do not omit task-scoped ordering obligations merely because their raw results are not in that context.

World.message records sends but is not itself a delivery mechanism. There are no native dedicated message IDs or received records. Actual forward consumption is registrar.run context assembly and actual return consumption is the Advisor tool-result history append; receipt recording must observe these paths without inventing delivery.

P8/P11: Role allowlists are enforced by Agent.run's configured definitions, not independently by every helper. Direct Python calls can bypass the agent-loop permission check, and advisor_tool's fallback lacks an explicit operation-name check. Caller labels alone are not authentication; capabilities must reflect trusted construction and originating role.

P11/P12: The synthetic auditor exception permits complete fixture traces locally, not disclosure through agent replies or real-student exports. Public trace sanitization removes reasoning items' encrypted content but retains provider-supplied summaries and other output fields; it does not validate arbitrary text for secrets or private reasoning.

P12: Trusted credential loading additionally occurs in phase1.llm.load_env and OpenAIResponses.__init__; CLI trace writing occurs in phase1.app.main. Packaging uses phase1.submission.submission_files/check/package and scripts.course_submission.check/write_archive/package with allowlists and pattern-based credential scans. These are operator utilities, not exposed agent tools; the finite credential regex is not proof against every credential format or secret encoded in ordinary content.

No agent-created task queue, timer, automatic retry, seat hold, filesystem tool, arbitrary-code tool, external-service tool or supported capability-expansion workflow was found. The background-kind entries describe synchronous trusted initialization/audit infrastructure, not permission for agents to create background work.

No support classification or complete mediation claim is established by this inventory. Fixed-schema rule expressibility, refusal-result mapping, additive hook placement, all applicable policy exceptions and positive/negative execution coverage remain binding and verification obligations.
No complete natural-language disclosure, minimum relevance, override paraphrase, private-reasoning, secret, real-data or claim-to-receipt semantic producer; unsupported portions remain unimplemented.
No shared transaction for interruptions between original write statements or after effect/before observation publication. Native uncertain/faulted outcomes are not rollback evidence.
No ordinal pre-effect delegation rule or terminal receipt gate before every free-text final in the frozen schemas. Original post-run order/completeness checks can fail after effects.

No automatic observation outside an active record_execution, cross-process capture, arbitrary host imports/unwrapped functions, raw helper/registration calls, direct backend edits, transport calls or CLI/file packaging exports. These are trusted-host/unmediated paths, not agent tools.

Invalid tool names outside the frozen call contract have the existing protocol unknown_tool error, observed but no native action evaluation; original Agent.run validates actual role tool availability. Frozen internal registrar aliases are not public tool definitions.
Direct host dispatcher calls do not generate Agent action/observation inspection receipts. Tests requiring inspections execute the original Agent.run and World.log producer.

World.message itself is logging, not transport. Return consumption is observed at the next actual model-context submission, rather than an inline hook immediately at history.append. If execution stops between append and next submission, that receipt is missing; no delivery inferred.

Source/DependsOn graph captures direct supplied snapshot handles only and has incomplete origin/copy links. The frozen bundle selects no provenance enforcement; exact flow and content restrictions remain partial/unsupported.
Frozen snapshot schemas have no completeness marker. Producer exceptions stop evaluation, but absence is only sound in the documented synchronous complete-observation scope.
Synthetic local auditor state visibility is retained only for the declared synthetic lifecycle, not as a privacy guarantee for user exports or real records.
